_notes.members[].base_url: API root; the script POSTs to <base_url>/chat/completions (must be OpenAI-compatible).
_notes.members[].api_key_env: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Omit for keyless servers such as Ollama. Keys are never read from files.
_notes.chairman: Member name that writes the final answer. If it is unreachable, the top-scoring surviving member takes over.
_notes.language: Optional, e.g. 'Traditional Chinese'. Default: reply in the language of the question.
_notes.api_key: Not supported on purpose - set OPENAI_API_KEY etc. in your environment instead.
